title.zh: GDP 三面等价与增加值

description.zh: 生产法、支出法与收入法为何必然相等，为何减去进口不是“进口拉低 GDP”，以及无偿家务的生产边界。
description.en: Why production, expenditure, and income approaches must match, why subtracting imports cancels out, and where the production boundary sits.

title.zh: 名义与实际、链式费雪指数与替代偏差
title.en: Nominal vs Real, Chained Fisher & Substitution Bias

description.zh: 拉氏指数、帕氏指数与链式费雪指数如何拆开价与量，替代偏差从何而来，以及 CPI 与 GDP 平减指数的分叉。
description.en: How Laspeyres, Paasche, and chained Fisher indexes separate price from quantity, why substitution bias arises, and how CPI diverges from the GDP deflator.

title.zh: CPI 权重、等价租金 OER 与质量调整
title.en: CPI Weights, Owners' Equivalent Rent & Hedonic Adjustment

description.zh: 为什么个人体感通胀常偏离官方 CPI：篮子权重、自住业主等价租金（OER）、特征价格质量调整与核心通胀。
description.en: Why personal inflation differs from official CPI: expenditure weights, owners' equivalent rent, hedonic quality adjustments, and core CPI/PCE.

title.zh: 折年率、基数效应、季节调整与数据修订
title.en: Annualised Rates, Base Effects, Seasonal Adjustment & Revisions

description.zh: 环比折年与同比的区别、低基数回声、2×4 中心移动平均季调失灵，以及 ALFRED 真实 GDP 历史修订档案。
description.en: q/q SAAR vs y/y, base-effect echoes, seasonal adjustment shifts, and real-time ALFRED GDP vintage revisions (2008Q4, 2020Q2, 2022H1).

en: quarter over quarter vs year over year

title.zh: 购买力平价 PPP、均值与中位数及基尼系数
title.en: Purchasing Power Parity, Mean vs Median & Gini Coefficient

description.zh: 巴拉萨–萨缪尔森效应为何让低工资国家按 PPP 的 GDP 翻倍，以及顶层集中增长下人均 GDP 与中位数的分化。
description.en: Why the Balassa-Samuelson effect boosts PPP GDP in lower-wage economies, and how top-heavy growth splits mean GDP per capita from median income.

title.zh: U-3 与 U-6 失业率、贝弗里奇曲线与奥肯定律
title.en: U-3 vs U-6 Unemployment, Beveridge Curve & Okun's Law

description.zh: 灰心退出求职如何“美化”U-3、劳动参与率、美国 2001–2026 贝弗里奇曲线轨迹，以及跨越时期的奥肯定律斜率漂移。
description.en: How discouraged workers distort U-3, labour force participation, the 2001-2026 US Beveridge curve trajectory, and shifting Okun's law slopes.

title.zh: 经济周期、潜在产出与萨姆规则
title.en: Business Cycles, Potential Output & the Sahm Rule

description.zh: 为什么“两季负增长”不是 NBER 衰退标准、萨姆规则 1960–2026 的 11 次触发与 2024 年假阳性，以及 CBO 潜在产出修订。
description.en: Why two negative quarters do not define an NBER recession, all 11 Sahm rule triggers including July 2024, and revisions to CBO potential output.

title.zh: 索洛增长核算与全要素生产率（TFP）
title.en: Solow Growth Accounting & Total Factor Productivity

description.zh: 产出增长如何拆成资本、工时、人力资本与“无知余数” TFP，以及 1960–2023 美国战后生产率分解实证。
description.en: Decomposing growth into capital, hours, human capital, and the TFP residual across US postwar eras (1960-2023 Penn World Table & FRED).

title.zh: GDP 之外：家务、折旧、灾难悖论与卫星账户
title.en: Beyond GDP: Home Production, Depreciation & Disaster Paradox

description.zh: BEA 家务卫星账户（约占 23%–26%）、国内生产净值 NDP、飓风重建推高 GDP 的会计悖论与环境外部性。
description.en: Household production satellite accounts (~23-26%), net domestic product NDP, why disaster reconstruction raises GDP while destroying wealth, and environmental costs.

title.zh: 前沿测量：免费数字品、GDP-B、2025 SNA 与实时预测
title.en: Measurement Frontier: Free Digital Goods, GDP-B, 2025 SNA & Nowcasting

description.zh: 零元数字服务与消费者剩余（GDP-B）、2025 年 3 月联合国 2025 SNA 新标准、调查回复率下跌与央行实时预测。
description.en: Valuing zero-price digital services and AI via GDP-B, the March 2025 SNA overhaul, declining survey response rates, and real-time central-bank nowcasting.

label.zh: 把当年货币总额拆成物价与实际量
label.en: Split nominal GDP into price and real quantity

reason.zh: 第 1 章算出名义 GDP 总额后，第 2 章用拉氏、帕氏和链式费雪指数解决跨期比较时价格变化与结构替代的分离问题。
reason.en: After Chapter 1 pins down nominal GDP, Chapter 2 uses Laspeyres, Paasche, and chained Fisher indexes to separate price changes from real volume.

label.zh: 从指数公式落到个人购物篮与 CPI
label.en: Apply index formulas to household baskets and CPI

reason.zh: 第 3 章将第 2 章的权重和替代偏差带入真实 CPI 口径，剖析自住等价租金 OER、特征价格质量调整与个人体感通胀差异。
reason.en: Chapter 3 applies Chapter 2's weighting mechanics to real CPI measurement: OER, hedonic quality adjustments, core inflation, and personal basket drift.

label.zh: 实际增速公布后为什么还会反复改
label.en: Why real GDP growth still shifts after release

reason.zh: 第 4 章顺着实际 GDP 口径展开四大读数陷阱：环比折年放大、低基数回声、季节调整波形以及 ALFRED 真实历史数据修订。
reason.en: Chapter 4 examines four traps when reading real GDP growth: annualised rates, base-effect echoes, seasonal adjustment, and ALFRED vintage revisions.

label.zh: 从跨期物价换算走到跨国购买力平价
label.en: From cross-time deflators to cross-country PPP

reason.zh: 第 5 章把第 2 章的篮子比价推广到跨国对比，解释巴拉萨–萨缪尔森效应与汇率/PPP 分化，再用洛伦兹曲线拆开均值与中位数。
reason.en: Chapter 5 extends price-level comparison across borders via Balassa–Samuelson PPP and separates mean GDP per capita from median income via Lorenz curves.

label.zh: 用失业率拐点实时触发周期与萨姆规则
label.en: Turn unemployment inflection points into the Sahm rule

reason.zh: 第 7 章使用第 6 章拆解的 U-3 失业率构造萨姆规则 0.50 个百分点实时触发器，并对照 NBER 衰退判定与 CBO 潜在产出修订。
reason.en: Chapter 7 uses Chapter 6's U-3 unemployment rate to build the 0.50 pp Sahm rule trigger alongside NBER recession calls and CBO potential output revisions.

label.zh: 把实际产出增长拆成要素与全要素生产率
label.en: Decompose real output growth into inputs and TFP

reason.zh: 第 8 章在真实产出核算的基础上做索洛增长核算，将美国 1960–2023 年增长拆解为资本、工时、人力资本与 TFP 余数。
reason.en: Chapter 8 builds Solow growth accounting atop real output data, decomposing 1960–2023 US growth into capital, hours, human capital, and TFP.

label.zh: 追问第 1 章生产边界之外漏掉了什么
label.en: Question what Chapter 1's GDP boundary leaves out

reason.zh: 第 9 章直接审视第 1 章的生产边界，量化未付费家务卫星账户、资本折旧与灾害重建推高 GDP 却损害净财富的会计悖论。
reason.en: Chapter 9 revisits Chapter 1's production boundary to quantify household satellite accounts, depreciation (NDP), and the disaster-GDP paradox.

label.zh: 用 2025 SNA、GDP-B 与实时预测修补边界与时滞
label.en: Address boundaries and lags with 2025 SNA, GDP-B & nowcasting

reason.zh: 第 10 章展示边界问题的当代前沿方案：免费数字品与 GDP-B、2025 SNA 新口径，以及调查回复率下滑下的央行实时预测。
reason.en: Chapter 10 covers frontier responses to measurement gaps: zero-price digital services (GDP-B), the 2025 SNA standard, survey nonresponse, and nowcasting.

label.zh: 货币推动物价时，怎么把物价和实际产量拆开
label.en: Separate monetary price rises from real output

reason.zh: 第 2 章交叉引用《钱是从哪里来的》第 4 章：当物价因货币与通胀变动时，指数选取决定了名义增长中有多少算作实际产量。
reason.en: Chapter 2 cross-links where-money-comes-from #ch4: when prices move, index choice governs how much nominal growth counts as real output.

label.zh: 用巴拉萨–萨缪尔森模型解释真实汇率与 PPP 偏离
label.en: Model PPP gaps via Balassa–Samuelson non-tradables

reason.zh: 第 5 章与《钱是从哪里来的》第 9 章衔接，用可贸易品与不可贸易品生产率差异导出发展中经济体的 PPP 溢价。
reason.en: Chapter 5 connects to where-money-comes-from #ch9 by deriving the PPP gap from tradable vs non-tradable productivity differences.

label.zh: 右偏分布里人均均值会甩开中位数
label.en: Top-heavy skew pulls mean GDP per capita above median

reason.zh: 第 5 章直接引用平均数与中位数的偏态规律，用 10 分位洛伦兹曲线展示顶层集中增长时人均 GDP 涨 20% 而中位数几乎不动。
reason.en: Chapter 5 builds on mean-median skewness with a 10-decile Lorenz curve showing +20% mean growth leaving median income nearly flat.

label.zh: 用最小二乘斜率估算奥肯定律并观察时期漂移
label.en: Fit Okun's law with OLS and track regime slope drift

reason.zh: 第 6 章用最小二乘线性回归把 GDP 增速与失业率变化联成奥肯定律，并展示 1960–2019、2008–2019 与疫情后的斜率差异。
reason.en: Chapter 6 uses OLS regression to fit Okun's law across US eras and shows how outliers and structural shifts change the slope.

label.zh: 单一失业率口径作为目标时容易被参与率掩盖
label.en: Single headline metrics can mislead when participation shifts

reason.zh: 第 6 章引用《数字没有说谎，结论却错了》第 9 章（古德哈特定律）：只盯 U-3 失业率，灰心退出求职者反而会让它“变好看”。
reason.en: Chapter 6 cites Goodhart's Law from numbers-lie #c9: focusing solely on U-3 makes discouraged exits look like falling unemployment.

label.zh: 要素收入份额 α 直接左右 TFP 余数的读数
label.en: Factor income shares α directly shift the TFP residual

reason.zh: 第 8 章展示资本收入份额 α 如何改变索洛增长核算中的纯 TFP 读数，与《稀缺会搬家》的要素报酬分配形成互证。
reason.en: Chapter 8 shows how capital share α shifts the Solow TFP residual, pairing with scarcity-moves on factor income shares.
